verdict.rationale: Preventing AI training on user data is a fair privacy-posture question for a password manager holding user data, so the axis applies. The pack documents end-to-end encryption, but nothing addresses AI-training use, a no-training policy, or a training opt-out. Encryption is an adjacent control, not the named capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
